messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Sunbird is starting a 2-week pilot tomorrow; they need an IP allowlist + temporary rate-window increase for AP-South edge. Their launcher will egress from 3 static IPs and via a GCP region we don't currently allow. Can infra/provisioning take this?
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Thanks Maya. Can you paste the three IPs and their account id? Also what's the expected RPS and exact pilot window?
Maya (CS): IPs: 34.83.12.9, 34.83.12.10, 35.200.99.18
Account: sunbird-prod-98
Expected: 40 rps steady, 120 rps spikes for 5m every 10m during 09:00–11:00 IST. Pilot window: 2026-03-22 -> 2026-04-05
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Ack. Proposed temporary rate config:
```
route: sunbird-pilot
allowlist_ips: ["34.83.12.9","34.83.12.10","35.200.99.18"]
region: ap-south1
rate_limit: { steady: 40, burst: 120, burst_window_sec: 300 }
window: 2026-03-22T00:00Z/2026-04-05T23:59Z
```
Can infra confirm capacity and egress rules?
Liam (Infra): AP-South capacity is ~70% this week. We can add the allowlist and the route, but recommend fallback routing to ap-east1 if we hit saturation. Also need approval to open egress to `gcp-southasia` for those IPs — security sign-off needed for pilot? @security?
Maya (CS): Security sign-off received from customer-compliance; they provided SOC2 docs and a contact. No additional KMS config required.
Liam (Infra): OK. I'll queue the config changes and pin the route to hosted pool with a cost alert. ETA ~15m.
ops-bot: Change request 1945012345 accepted, task infra/PROV-8372 created by ops-bot
Ethan (Solutions Eng): When applied, please run a smoke test and paste a curl that returns 200 for their key.
Liam (Infra): Applied rules. Smoke test:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-sunbird-pilot" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":5}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
Maya (CS): :tada: Pilot go-live tomorrow confirmed. I'll send enablement notes to Sunbird and schedule a day-3 check-in. Thanks team!
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Noted. Flagging renewal risk: if pilot grows >2x we should propose Dedicated/reserved capacity; I'll prepare a cost estimate and a short trade-off note.
Maya (CS): Adding to account-health tracker and renewal pipeline. Will attach pilot metrics during the post-pilot debrief and close this thread after the debrief.
